status: proposed acceptance plan; cases are unimplemented and unexecuted
evidencePolicy: Every listed fixture/case is a future requirement, not existing test evidence. C0 validates this plan only. Record actual independent results, provenance, skips and unavailable tools per executable leaf.
executionPolicy: Use AGENTS.md required full English-OCR modern-runtime checks; compatible Windows Framework plus exact-package/Standard and actual-minimum-runtime qualification remain distinct. No Android/macOS release claim.

sharedCases.assertion: Preserve signed IDs/tags/aliases and order; assign missing IDs deterministically with information; reject duplicate/exhausted IDs, unknown types/properties, malformed values, nested controls and unsupported owners before returning a session.

Exercise absent/unlocked/sdtLocked/contentLocked/sdtContentLocked with every typed setter and placeholder/apply/detach operation; failed edits keep original model/version/diagnostics. No bypass via Replace/Append/Merge.

Foreign, stale and wrong-kind handles fail; committed metadata/typed edits, including zero-change commits, invalidate old handles; failed/cancelled calls and Save do not. Detached snapshots remain unchanged.

Typed merge/image/if/repeat tags never execute. Duplicate tags return separate handles. Merge rejects before caller getters/JSON evaluation; explicit display view removes typed tags and leaves original and unrelated legacy template behavior intact.

Metadata edits/save retain typed state, formatting and neighboring nested fields/bookmarks; mutate caller formatting/collections after input and verify detachment. Ordinary Replace/bookmark/Append/retained-review/object combinations reject atomically.
independentOracles: independent raw XML for field boundaries and controls

sharedCases.assertion: Exercise pre-cancel and traversal/enumeration cancellation, count/depth/characters/bytes/work at limit and limit+1, many small metadata entries and checked overflow. No pre-copy failure writes caller output; streams stay open. Final-copy I/O behavior follows caller-stream contract.

DOCX retains editable state; managed PDF/XPS has selectable static value/placeholder and information. Strict non-DOCX editable loss rejects before copy; BestEffort/Lenient/display-view flatten explicitly. Native/tagged/archive/unqualified combinations reject.

Record authored fixture provenance, font hashes/licenses, expected text/order/coordinates and diagnostic policy. Keep independent failures and unavailable consumer/UI tools explicit; do not qualify a platform by compilation or a self round trip.

cases.assertion: Preserve checked/unchecked and omitted-state defaults, signed ID, tag/alias, original optional glyph/font declarations and neighboring Unicode text through independent DOCX inspection. Verify emitted property order and required Office2010 namespace/markup-compatibility declarations.

Both checkbox states render correctly with pinned glyph coverage; a deliberately unavailable glyph/font yields selectable [x]/[ ] with Control.GlyphFallback while editable DOCX retains its declaration. Mismatched source cache refresh is informational.
Reject invalid Boolean/hex, surrogate/non-BMP code, multiple content characters and retained deleted runs, without output or session mutation.

Retain cache-only placeholder versus actual value and a bounded local glossary reference/entry/relationship; explicit set clears placeholder and explicit reset restores authored text. Reject missing/duplicate/rich/external glossary entries and aggregate expansion.
Preserve item order, explicit/omitted display labels, Unicode stored values, selected label and optional lastValue; a stored empty value remains distinct from no selection and placeholder.

Dropdown selection accepts exact ordinal member values only. Combo permits bounded literal nonmember text. Unbound lastValue is not an index/selection authority. Invalid selection leaves model/version unchanged. Reject free text colliding with an item label or bound member value; empty combo text canonicalizes to no selection.

Exercise zero items, null selection, empty stored value with nonempty label, placeholder, unmatched nonempty cache and absent displayText fallback. A dropdown nonmember stays explicitly unresolved; an unbound combo nonmember is literal free text; duplicate values/labels and empty effective labels fail.
Exercise 256 items/control, 4096 aggregate, item/tag string and aggregate byte/work boundaries; invalid late item enumeration cannot partially commit.
Reject multiple formatting sets/paragraphs, nested controls, rich item payload and dataBinding until C5; retain surrounding legacy merge/condition behavior on the ordinary entry point.

Explicit DateOnly mode preserves canonical midnight fullDate and Y/M/D across leap day, year 1/year 9999, save/reload with same policy, placeholder/null/empty and en-US/en-GB case variants. No clock/text inference.

Explicit-offset instants display deterministically in UTC across offset date boundaries, under two host cultures/timezones and supplied fixed values; retain original date/storage metadata and diagnose cache refresh.

Reject invalid leap days/ranges, offset-less instants, DateOnly non-midnight/offset input, unsupported calendars/locales, absent/unsupported mask and DateOnly time tokens without partial mutation or date truncation.

Exercise every admitted F2 date token/literal, missing fullDate with literal unresolved cache, explicit null and authored placeholder reset. Keep ordinary DATE/TIME and legacy merge behavior unchanged.
Enforce 128-character picture, 64 tokens, 1024 displayed units and aggregate work/output bounds, with cancellation before commit.

Preserve explicit richText and omitted-type controls with Unicode, bold/italic/underline/font/size/color and ordinary paragraph spacing/alignment/heading role; replace from copied caller values and verify detached snapshots.

Preserve adjacent nested fields, closed bookmarks and separate controls exactly; reject fields/bookmarks inside or crossing owners and unsupported paragraph formatting. Late invalid replacement is atomic.
Reject tables, revisions/comments, object/image-bearing content, nested controls, section changes and unsupported stories; no silent fragment flattening or control-tag execution.

Distinguish empty value from authored placeholder; bound runs/paragraphs/characters/structure/bytes and cancellation during enumeration; locked/stale replacement preserves session/version/diagnostics.

Preserve local customXml/itemProps/relationships/storeItemID and namespace mappings by infoset/part identity, including case-insensitive GUID matching and multiple distinct stores. No implicit XML synchronization on load/save.

Apply/write back namespaced and empty-namespace child paths, redundant [1] only for actual singleton, and final attributes. Reject zero/multiple matches, undeclared/duplicate mappings and missing targets without creating nodes.

Reject external/escaping relationships, missing/duplicate store IDs, DTD/entities/PIs, //, .., wildcards, unions, functions, arbitrary predicates/indices and namespace updates. Never invoke resolver/network/script.

Apply/write back checkbox true/false/1/0, exact dropdown stored values, combo member/free text, DateOnly/date and instant/dateTime, and literal w:text with multiline policy. Reject incompatible lexical types, null/placeholder/unresolved write-back and date text storage inference. Reject combo nonmember XML values colliding with an existing item label.

Reject richText dataBinding rather than pretending plain rich content is a bound w:text. Strings containing XML, merge tags or code remain escaped literal text; reject structured/mixed element target overwrite.

Explicit Apply replaces control values, explicit WriteBack changes XML and explicit unlocked Detach removes mapping. Dirty DOCX save rejects until an explicit decision; unchanged unevaluated graph is disclosed. Locked/stale/late-invalid multi-control work cannot partially commit.

Write-back requires all controls sharing a target; reject divergent converted values regardless of enumeration order. Identical converted values succeed once, without last-writer-wins or unrelated changes.

Exercise store/entry/node/attribute/namespace/path/depth/UTF-16/expanded-byte/work ceilings individually and in aggregate, including many small parts, malformed late stores, repeated binding walks and cancellation.
